segments.motivation: To visually organize and track project progress and tasks for teams.
To manage personal and small team tasks, organize workflows, and keep track of responsibilities efficiently and affordably.
To facilitate team collaboration, ensure transparency on shared projects, and delegate tasks effectively.

tasks.context: visually on boards using cards and lists
tasks.purpose: to maintain an overview of work

tasks.context: by sharing boards and assigning tasks
tasks.purpose: to keep everyone on the same page and facilitate collective work

tasks.context: using customizable cards with due dates and attachments
tasks.purpose: to ensure tasks are completed on time
to simplify processes and focus on critical work

tasks.object: personal to-do lists and daily responsibilities

benefits.claim: The product provides an intuitive and visually organized overview of projects and tasks, making it easy to see progress.
It enhances team collaboration and transparency by allowing easy sharing of boards and clear assignment of tasks.
The platform is highly customizable to fit various workflows and integrates seamlessly with other essential applications.

frictions.claim: Boards can become overwhelming or cluttered when managing very large or highly complex projects.
The product may lack advanced features for detailed time tracking, reporting, or sophisticated data manipulation.
Some advanced customization or features may require a paid subscription, which can be a consideration for users.
